targets.rawSql: SELECT user_name, SUM(total_tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS turns FROM tedros_core.tai_usage_event WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT user_name, elem->>'name' AS tool, elem->>'outcome' AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM tedros_core.tai_usage_event t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.tool_calls::jsonb) AS elem WHERE t.tool_calls IS NOT NULL AND t.ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY user_name, elem->>'name', elem->>'outcome' ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1h'), user_name AS metric, SUM(total_tokens) AS tokens FROM tedros_core.tai_usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, user_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT user_name, error_code, COUNT(*) AS errors FROM tedros_core.tai_usage_event WHERE outcome = 'ERROR' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY user_name, error_code ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 50
